name: Transcode Downloader [✓✓]
description:
Adds a quality-selection download button to Jellyfin item detail pages.  
  
Universal Repo:  
Generated: 07:13 UTC  
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ph15ch/Jellyfin-Transcode-Downloader/main/repo/manifest.json  
Github: https://github.com/ph15ch/Jellyfin-Transcode-Downloader
overview: Adds a 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to the More menu on every movie and episode detail page. Selecting it opens a quality picker — choose a bitrate tier and Jellyfin re-encodes the video server-side to H.264/AAC, streaming it to your browser with a live progress bar, or pick Original to save the unmodified source file directly. Requires the File Transformation companion plugin (>= v2.2.1.0) for permission-safe script injection.

versions.changelog:
feat: choose video and audio codec for transcoded downloads

- The quality sheet now offers a video and an audio codec picker, limited to
  what the server actually has enabled
- Downloads started from an episode list target the episode whose menu you
  opened, instead of the season or series the page is showing
- Failed or empty transcodes now report the real HTTP status instead of
  silently producing a broken file
fix: transcoding actually respects selected quality tier.
fix: i18n strings now load in the correct Jellyfin UI language (de, us, es, fr, nl, zh-cn)

Fix queue panel resetting progress bar when new items are added

Incremental DOM updates replace full re-renders so the active download's
progress bar is preserved when a second item joins the queue.

Add multi-download queue

Downloads now enqueue instead of starting immediately. Each queued item has its own cancel button; cancelling removes only that item and the next starts automatically. The bottom-right panel shows all queued items with live progress for the active one. Queue is in-memory only.
Update logo, rename console prefix to [TranscodeDownloader], fix README and manifest

Fix transcode quality tiers and stale item on first page load

- On first load, quality sheet now awaits metadata before building the
  tier list, so only valid bitrates (below source bitrate) are shown
- Quality sheet now re-derives the item ID from the URL at open time,
  preventing downloads targeting the previous movie when navigating
  between items before the hash-change event fires

Replace dropdown button with action sheet menu entry

- Remove injected select+button from the detail page
- Add 'Download (Transcode…)' entry to Jellyfin's native 'Mehr' menu
- Quality selection via a second overlay in Jellyfin's action sheet style
- Fixes reload-required bug; no longer disrupts the detail page layout

fix: show plugin logo in catalog and installed plugin detail page

- Add imageUrl to manifest.json so the catalog displays the logo
- Include logo.png in the release zip for the installed plugin detail page

rename: QuickDownload → Transcode Downloader + add logo and build CI

- Plugin display name is now "Transcode Downloader"
- All internals renamed to Jellyfin.Plugin.TranscodeDownloader
- Controller route changed to /TranscodeDownloader/ClientScript
- Added logo.png
- Added PR build workflow

Fix: force transcode to honour selected quality tier

Without allowVideoStreamCopy=false Jellyfin could direct-stream the
original file, ignoring MaxStreamingBitrate and MaxHeight entirely.
Downloads now correctly re-encode to the selected resolution and bitrate.

Fix: force transcode to honour selected quality tier

Without allowVideoStreamCopy=false Jellyfin could direct-stream the
original file, ignoring MaxStreamingBitrate and MaxHeight entirely.
Downloads now correctly re-encode to the selected resolution and bitrate.
fix: delay revokeObjectURL to prevent download failure after completion

fix: button appears on first load without page reload

Replace 20x250ms polling retry loop with a MutationObserver that fires
the moment Jellyfin's SPA renders the detail-view container. The old
loop could time out before the SPA finished hydrating, requiring a
manual page reload to see the download button.

fix: use ApiClient.getItem() for metadata fetch to avoid 401

Jellyfin 10.11 rejects api_key query-param auth on the Items endpoint,
causing the dropdown to stay empty. Switch to client.getItem() which
sends the correct Authorization header.

fix: populate dropdown after UI injection to eliminate race condition

The metadata fetch often completed before Jellyfin rendered the detail
container, so populateDropdown() exited early (select === null) without
ever setting currentItem. Clicking Download then silently did nothing.

- Move currentItem assignment before the early return in populateDropdown()
- Re-call populateDropdown() after injecting the UI if data already arrived
- Reset currentItem when navigating to a new item to avoid stale options

fix: strip Accept-Encoding/Content-Encoding to prevent compressed-body corruption

Jellyfin's static file middleware serves index.html pre-compressed when the
client advertises Accept-Encoding. The IStartupFilter middleware was buffering
those compressed bytes and writing them back with Content-Encoding: gzip still
set, causing browsers to report 'cannot decode raw data'.

Fix: remove Accept-Encoding from the request before intercepting so upstream
never activates compression; also strip Content-Encoding from the response.

fix: inject script tag via middleware — button now appears without companion plugins

The script tag is now injected by an ASP.NET Core IStartupFilter that
intercepts index.html responses in Jellyfin's HTTP pipeline. No File
Transformation plugin required, no disk writes, no timing sensitivity.

Also fixes plugin loading error in the admin UI (Plugin constructor now
calls SetAttributes).

fix: call SetAttributes in Plugin constructor so CanUninstall doesn't throw

BasePlugin (non-generic) never calls SetAttributes — only BasePlugin<T> does
in its own constructor. Without it, AssemblyFilePath stays null, and
CanUninstall throws NullReferenceException when GET /Plugins serializes the
plugin list, breaking the admin plugins page on every page load.

Fix: inject IApplicationPaths and call SetAttributes the same way BasePlugin<T>
does, giving Jellyfin a valid assembly path and data folder path.

Serve client script from controller and inject in-memory

- QuickDownloadController serves the embedded plugin.js at GET /QuickDownload/ClientScript (AllowAnonymous) so the web root never needs to be writable
- WebAssetInjector registers an in-memory File Transformation callback instead of patching index.html on disk; survives Jellyfin web updates and is auto-removed on plugin uninstall
- On-disk fallback retained for installs without File Transformation, with a loud actionable log recommending FT >= v2.2.1.0
- Base-path-aware script src for Jellyfin deployments behind a sub-path

Cache-bust plugin.js on injection

Add a ?v={assembly version} query to the injected plugin.js script tag so
browsers reload the script after a plugin upgrade instead of serving a stale
cached copy. First release cut via the new fully tag-driven release pipeline.
Initial baseline release.

versions.changelog:

- Fixed selected voice tracks changing after a library scan.

- Fixed cleanup of releases removed from your YummyAnime list when automatic removal is enabled.
- Improved borrowed intro and outro timings by comparing available voice tracks. Existing fallback behavior is preserved when timings disagree.

Requires Jellyfin 10.11.

- Your selected voice track stays selected when moving to the next episode, including choices made through Jellyfin's standard version selector.
- On slow connections, the player buffers video ahead of playback and shows buffering progress.

Requires Jellyfin 12.

- Your selected voice track stays selected when moving to the next episode, including choices made through Jellyfin's standard version selector.
- On slow connections, the player buffers video ahead of playback and shows buffering progress.
- Improved playback recovery after temporary loading failures.
- Reduced unnecessary load during library refreshes.
- Fixed issues with episode information and available voice tracks.

Requires Jellyfin 10.11.

## What changed

- Added a complete series voice selector that includes translations available through Jellyfin versions and all supported providers, including Kodik-only coverage.
- A selected voice now stays active across episodes: Jellyfin `Next` and autoplay advance in that voice wherever it is available. `Auto` restores normal automatic selection.
- Improved playback recovery for Alloha, CVH, and Kodik streams, including temporary provider failures, expired stream resources, stalls, and quality fallback.
- Added more accurate episode runtimes and earlier intro/outro skip availability when provider metadata is available.
- Made repeated library refreshes substantially faster when titles and generated files are unchanged, while still rechecking provider coverage when needed.
- Improved mixed-provider libraries where one provider has only part of a season or a translation is available from a different provider.
- Added an optional safe cleanup setting for plugin-managed releases removed from a successfully fetched Yummy user list. It is disabled by default.

## Compatibility

- Requires Jellyfin 10.11.x and .NET 9, unchanged from the previous release.
- Existing plugin configuration remains compatible. The old Jellyfin server base URL value is retained for compatibility but is no longer used or shown; generated streams now use Jellyfin's local gateway automatically.
- Voice selection is series-wide because Jellyfin stores the primary episode version globally. Different users cannot keep independent simultaneous voice locks for the same series.

## After updating

- Replace or install the plugin files, then restart Jellyfin.
- Run `Scheduled Tasks -> YummyKodik library refresh` once. The first refresh can take longer because generated metadata and refresh state are upgraded.
- Scan the Jellyfin library that points at the generated folder after that refresh.
- Use `Auto` in the series voice selector before making a one-off choice through Jellyfin's native version selector.

## What changed

- Made library refresh faster while keeping external API pressure conservative. Refresh workers can process different titles in parallel, but the default limit remains 2.
- Added a single-run gate so a second refresh exits quickly instead of doing duplicate work.
- Added per-series filesystem locks so season folder migration, cleanup, STRM/NFO writes, and state writes are serialized for the same series root.
- Split the refresh flow into smaller services for title loading, metadata writing, episode generation, Kodik supplementing, state checks, and cleanup.
- Added refresh state files for safe single-file skips. State is multi-season, written atomically, and never stores raw provider tokens, cookies, bearer tokens, or secret-bearing URLs.
- Added strict skip validation. The plugin now checks fingerprints, covered episodes, managed file hashes, missing files, and stale episode-shaped artifacts before skipping a title.
- Kept per-voice mode conservative. It still runs full provider lookup so new voice translation files can appear even when episode counts do not change.
- Made corrupt, missing, stale, or ambiguous refresh state fall back to a full refresh instead of failing or skipping too aggressively.
- Improved stale artifact cleanup for generated episode STRM/NFO files, including zero-episode and future-episode cases.
- Improved legacy season folder and episode filename migration under the series-root lock.
- Fixed atomic text writes so existing read-only generated STRM/NFO files can be replaced during refresh.
- Made Shikimori layout caching safe for concurrent refresh workers.
- Made shared Kodik token and lookup paths safer under parallel refresh and runtime playback.
- Delayed Kodik client initialization until a title actually needs Kodik supplement data.
- Added refresh performance diagnostics for slow-stage and file-operation troubleshooting.
- Added a configurable Minimum plugin log level. The default is Warning, so normal refresh and playback no longer spam Jellyfin with informational YummyKodik logs.
- Fixed a logging startup regression by avoiding global ILogger replacement and filtering only YummyKodik loggers.
- Improved Alloha/CVH/Kodik fallback handling, voice matching, playlist proxy recovery, and token refresh behavior used by runtime playback.

versions.changelog:
Jellyfin 10.11.9+ compatibility and recommendation-quality fixes
- Fixes MissingMethodException crash on Jellyfin 10.11.9/10.11.10 (#17, fixes #21): all IUserManager.Users call sites now use GetUsers()
- TV series now weighted by most recently watched episode date instead of always 'today' (#19)
- Replaced play-count rewatch boost with recency-driven Recent Watch Emphasis using decay-squared amplification (#20); the RewatchBoost setting becomes RecentWatchBoost (default 1.0)
- Config page numeric fields saved as 0 no longer revert to defaults (#22)
- REQUIRES Jellyfin 10.11.9 or newer

Migrate from .strm files to filesystem symlinks (#13)
- Fixes transcoded playback on Jellyfin 10.11.7+ (GHSA-j2hf-x4q5-47j3)
- Symlinks preserve source extensions; media pipeline treats them as regular files
- Artwork symlinked from source folder (propagates custom posters automatically)
- Trailer discovery delegated to Jellyfin's native scanner
- Removed ImageSyncService and EnableImageSync/SyncBackdrops settings
- WINDOWS: requires Administrator or Developer Mode enabled for symlink creation

Filter recommendations by user library access (#10)
- Items from libraries a user cannot access are excluded from recommendations
- Applies to both personalized and cold-start recommendation paths
- Respects per-user library permissions including disabled libraries

Fix playback freeze when playing from recommendation libraries (#8)
- Never remove virtual library items from event handlers (deferred to next refresh)
- Ignore PlaybackStart/PlaybackProgress events to prevent DB write storms during playback
- Only sync play status on meaningful events (PlaybackFinished, TogglePlayed, etc.)
- Known tradeoff: partially watched items may appear in Continue Watching twice until next refresh

Bug fixes for series recommendations and playback crashes
- Fixed: Partially watched series not included in watch history, causing all users to get identical cold-start recommendations (#7)
- Fixed: Playback from recommendation libraries crashing with database failures (#8)
- Series watch history now detected at episode level instead of requiring all episodes watched
- Virtual library items no longer removed during active playback

Image sync for custom posters and backdrops
- Custom poster images are now preserved in recommendation libraries
- Copies poster.jpg and backdrop.jpg from source items to virtual folders
- Configurable: Enable/disable image sync and backdrop copying
- Fixes issue where user customizations (e.g., French posters) were lost

Decade-based temporal similarity and bug fix
- Recommendations now consider content from similar time periods
- Decade grouping (1980s, 1990s, etc.) replaces continuous year normalization
- Improves temporal relevance alongside genre/actor/director similarity
- Tested with production data: ~12 decades extracted from 970 items
- Observable impact: 24% of movie recommendations changed, 8% of TV
- Fixed: In-progress TV series no longer appear in recommendations

Series filtering fix and play status sync
- Fixed fully watched series appearing in recommendations
- Play status sync from source library when virtual items are scanned
- Rating proximity scoring feature
- Removed NFO file generation (Jellyfin doesn't read NFO for .strm files)
- Reduced debug logging noise

Fix NFO metadata parsing
- Fixed XML encoding (UTF-16 to UTF-8) so Jellyfin reads runtime correctly
- Added cast, directors, and writers to NFO files
- Added fileinfo/streamdetails for video/audio/subtitle stream selectors

NFO metadata and trailer support
- NFO files with full metadata (runtime, ratings, genres, studios, tags)
- Local trailer support via -trailer.strm files
- Movie folder structure for better metadata handling
- Fixed copy buttons on setup page
- Improved documentation

Initial beta release
- Per-user personalized recommendations for movies and TV shows
- Content-based filtering using TF-IDF embeddings
- Virtual library integration for universal client compatibility
- Configurable weighting (favorites, rewatches, recency)
- Abandoned series exclusion
- Daily scheduled updates with manual refresh option
- Complete privacy - all processing local

- Feature: UI rework — single Browse tab with provider switching (AniWorld, SerienStream, Filmo, FilmPalast, MegaKino, Moflix) and a "Search All" that queries every source at once
- Feature: Tabbed settings page — one tab per site plus a General tab
- UI: Mobile-optimized layout; emoji replaced with bundled Font Awesome icons (no CDN, works offline)
- Change: Default s.to base URL is now https://serienstream.to (still changeable in settings)
- Fix: Search and Search All buttons now always the same width

v1.6.1.0
- Added language fallback. Thanks to Alexius25 on GitHub
- Removed remaining dead HiAnime code
- Removed: FlareSolverr integration. s.to has moved its provider redirector behind a Cloudflare Turnstile widget that activates per-IP for flagged egress addresses. FlareSolverr cannot solve embedded Turnstile widgets that require user interaction, so the integration was not actually helping affected users. If your server's IP is gated, route the plugin's outbound traffic through a clean proxy via the existing Proxy Server setting (SOCKS5 / HTTP supported).

v1.6.0.0
- Feature: Automatic DDoS-Guard / Cloudflare challenge bypass via optional FlareSolverr integration - solved cookies are cached and reused so the round-trip is only paid on a fresh challenge
- Feature: Movie download support for s.to and aniworld.to (#17, thanks @Alexius25)
- Feature: Force option to re-download episodes already marked as downloaded
- Feature: SOCKS5 / HTTP proxy support for outbound traffic to streaming sites
- Feature: Manual "Rebuild download history" scheduled task to resync the database with files on disk
- Fix: Movie detection and downloading reliability
- Fix: Removed legacy scheduled task that was a no-op

v1.5.3.0
- Feature: Configurable s.to base URL in plugin settings — use an alternative domain (e.g. serienstream.to) if s.to is blocked by your ISP
- Fix: ffmpeg not found on Windows servers with custom Jellyfin install locations — removed hardcoded fallback paths in favor of Jellyfin's configured ffmpeg path

v1.5.2.0
- Fix: ffmpeg not found on Windows servers — now uses Jellyfin's own ffmpeg path via IMediaEncoder with fallback to platform-specific search

v1.5.1.0
- Feature: Maintenance mode to block users from adding episodes to queue
- Feature: Priority queueing for downloads

- Feature: Better formatted statistics in history view
- Fix: Priority queue not properly displaying in the UI

- Fix: Build error from misplaced constant declaration

- Feature: Option to force English-dub only downloads for HiAnime

versions.changelog: - Fix: the v1.0.3.0 sidebar entry didn't actually appear — Jellyfin gates main-menu items on `EnableInMainMenu`, not just `MenuSection`. Setting both now puts Show Tracker in the dashboard sidebar.
- Improvement: the Show Tracker page now appears as its own entry in the Jellyfin Dashboard sidebar (Server section), instead of being buried under Dashboard → Plugins → My Plugins → Show Tracker.

- Feature: clicking a show's poster or title in the dashboard now opens that show's page in your Jellyfin library (jumps straight to the seasons/episodes view). Expand/collapse on the rest of the row still works for inspecting missing episodes inline.

- Fix: the "Scan Now" button was partially covered by Jellyfin's fixed top-right header — the top and right edges intercepted clicks. The page now reserves padding to clear the AppBar and the Cast/Search/User icon cluster.

- Fix: dashboard page no longer stuck on "Loading scan results..." — corrected the embedded script's URL, moved inline styles into the page body so Jellyfin's config-page loader doesn't strip them, and normalized PascalCase responses on the client.
- Improvement: smarter episode comparison that handles libraries using a different season layout than TVMaze. Falls back to title/airdate matching, detects absolute (anime-style) numbering, and flags shows where the TVMaze match is likely wrong (e.g. anime vs. live-action remake with the same name).
- New per-show `MatchMode` and `MatchConfidence` fields, surfaced in the dashboard as a "Match info" note.

- Initial release
- TVMaze integration with rate limiting and caching
- Dashboard page with missing episode reports
- Scheduled nightly scanning
- REST API for external integrations

versions.changelog: v0.9.0 - Grande passe de durcissement issue d'un 3e audit ultra-complet (10 dimensions, revue adversariale multi-agents) : 6 corrections MEDIUM + ~29 durcissements LOW, 0 critique/eleve restant. Recommandee. PAS DE MIGRATION. Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. MEDIUM : (1) coller un emoji au ras d'une limite de longueur pouvait faire echouer la sauvegarde de config (500 ; troncature UTF-16 rune-safe) ; (2) annuler l'avertissement 'utilisateurs en streaming' n'efface plus silencieusement les modifs de l'onglet Maintenance et n'affiche plus un faux succes ; (3) modales Uptime Kuma / Import accessibles (role=dialog, focus piege, Echap, focus restitue) ; (4) reordonnancement des lignes au clavier (fleches haut/bas) ; (5) la couche d'enforcement anti-SSRF des webhooks est desormais couverte par des tests ; (6) le pipeline de release verifie que l'URL d'asset du manifest correspond (anti-typo de casse type v0.6.0). LOW notables : anti lost-update entre onglets, purge des utilisateurs supprimes du suivi 'vu', tailles de boutons bornees, coherence de planning fixe C#/JS, ARIA onglets + navigation fleches, contrastes et cibles tactiles WCAG, garde double-execution du script injecte, un seul fetch /maintenance par navigation, test de reflexion des tiers d'autorisation, coherence de version sur 4 sources. + 2 liens de documentation corriges. 391 tests verts, build 0 warning.

v0.8.5 - Corrections UX/a11y/fonctionnel issues d'un 2e audit ultra-complet (toutes couches : UX, design, perf, code, a11y, docs ; 0 critique restant, 6 high corriges ici). Recommande. HIGH : (1) les modeles rapides d'annonce (ex : Halloween/Noel 'annuel') perdaient silencieusement leur planning / auto-expiration / theme / image -> l'annonce s'affichait toute l'annee au lieu de sa fenetre ; desormais tous les champs sont copies. (2) L'overlay de maintenance plein ecran a enfin la meme accessibilite que les modales d'annonce : role=dialog + aria-modal, focus piege a l'interieur, scroll de la page verrouille, focus restitue a la fermeture (avant : un utilisateur clavier/lecteur d'ecran pouvait tabuler derriere l'overlay). (3) En mode carousel, les cartes non visitees n'etaient jamais marquees 'vues' -> le carousel reapparaissait a chaque connexion ; maintenant toutes les cartes sont marquees a la fermeture. (4) Un redemarrage programme a la fin de la fenetre de maintenance etait annule silencieusement par la desactivation auto du meme tick -> il se declenche desormais correctement. (5) `make bump` (outil de dev) etait casse sur GNU sed (Git Bash / CI Linux). (6) README : exigence Jellyfin corrigee 10.11.6 -> 10.11.10. MEDIUM : cap sur le NOMBRE d'elements des collections (annonces 200 / messages 100 / etc.) anti-bloat config.xml ; image hero d'annonce masquee si l'URL est morte (plus d'icone cassee) ; pluralisation '1 annonce'. TESTS : 366/366 verts (+3 caps), build 0 warning, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.4 - Release de SECURITE + corrections (suite a un audit adverse multi-agents). Recommande pour tous. SECURITE (webhook SSRF, durci sur 3 couches) : la defense SSRF de v0.7.0 etait contournable. Corrige : (1) le HttpClient webhook suivait les redirections HTTP -> un hote public autorise pouvait renvoyer un 302 vers 169.254.169.254 (metadata cloud) / loopback / LAN ; desormais AllowAutoRedirect=false + un ConnectCallback qui re-valide l'IP REELLE de chaque connexion (bat aussi le DNS rebinding). (2) les litteraux IPv6-mappes (::ffff:169.254.169.254) et les hotes a point final (127.0.0.1.) contournaient la blocklist -> normalisation MapToIPv4 + trailing-dot. (3) ajout des plages ::, CGNAT 100.64/10, fec0::/10, broadcast. NB : configurer un webhook reste admin-only (RequiresElevation), donc l'attaque exige un admin malveillant ou piege. CORRECTIONS (audit) : (a) la desactivation manuelle de la maintenance n'est plus annulee par le planificateur (consommation du ScheduledStart passe + garde ScheduledEnd) ; (b) ajouter un user a la whitelist PENDANT la maintenance le reactive immediatement, le drift-check respecte la whitelist live ; (c) modele de concurrence APPLIQUE : tous les writers de config (SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements/MarkSeen/ResetSeen + tache planifiee) passent par un verrou unique -> fin des pertes d'ecriture et du config.xml corrompu ; (d) les annonces recurrentes (daily/weekly/annual) sont evaluees en heure LOCALE serveur (etait UTC) -> elles s'affichent aux bonnes heures, alignees sur les bannieres (positionne le TZ du conteneur) ; (e) cap sur la taille de reponse webhook (anti-OOM) + try/catch global sur la tache planifiee ; (f) admin.js : fix d'une fuite de listeners (double-binding a chaque pageshow). CI : la garde ASCII attrape desormais U+2028/2029/0085 ; release.yml lance dotnet test avant de publier ; creation de release idempotente. TESTS : 363/363 verts (etait 316), correctifs SSRF mutation-verifies, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.3 - Release de durcissement qualite (reponse a un audit adverse). AUCUN changement de feature, AUCUN changement de comportement du plugin shippe : le DLL est fonctionnellement identique a v0.8.2. La seule modif du code shippe est un refactor interne behavior-preserving (extraction de MaintenanceHelper.SetUserDisabledAsync, la glue IUserManager.GetUserDto+UpdatePolicyAsync, factorisee depuis les 3 boucles activate/deactivate/drift-check) verifie equivalent par mutation testing. Tout le reste est de l'infra de test/CI qui ne part PAS dans le zip : (1) Garde anti-tests-vacuous via Stryker.NET (mutation testing) sur les helpers de logique pure (AnnouncementHelper + MaintenanceHelper), workflow dedie manuel+hebdo, seuil de non-regression. (2) +21 tests xUnit (295 -> 316) : durcissement HasUserSeen/MarkSeen, round-trip XML de PluginConfiguration (compat legacy + champs non-null), builders de payload webhook Discord/Slack/Generic, vecteurs XSS sur SAFE_URL_RE, et surtout 15 tests d'integration HTTP qui pilotent SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements a travers un VRAI Plugin (BasePlugin sur dossier temp + XmlSerializer reel) avec preuve de persistance disque. (3) Smoke test de deploiement reel qui gate les releases : boot d'un vrai serveur Jellyfin (matrix 10.11.6 plancher targetAbi + 10.11.10 prod) avec le DLL monte, completion du wizard, auth admin, puis appel de /users-summary et /announcements/admin (les endpoints qui appellent IUserManager.GetUsers() - EXACTEMENT la methode qui crashait en MissingMethodException sur 10.11.9) + scan des logs serveur. Ce gate aurait attrape le bug v0.8.0 avant publication. TESTS : 316/316 verts sur SDK 10.11.10, refactor mutation-verifie (24/24 + nouveaux KILLED). PAS DE MIGRATION. Recommande pour 10.11.10+ ; equivalent fonctionnel a v0.8.2.

v0.8.2 - Compat refresh Jellyfin 10.11.10. Aucun changement de code, aucun changement de feature : juste un rebuild contre le SDK Jellyfin 10.11.10 (release patch sortie cote serveur) + bump targetAbi de 10.11.9.0 a 10.11.10.0 pour que Jellyfin 10.11.10+ accepte l'install sans warning. AUDIT API : diff complet de IUserManager + ISessionManager entre 10.11.9 et 10.11.10 = 0 difference, toutes les methodes utilisees (GetUsers, GetUserById, GetUserByName, GetUserDto, UpdatePolicyAsync, Sessions) ont signature identique. v0.8.1 (build 10.11.9) marche aussi sur 10.11.10 grace a la forward-compat Jellyfin meme-minor, mais ce binaire v0.8.2 est strictement aligne sur la derniere API. TESTS : 279/279 verts sur SDK 10.11.10. PAS DE MIGRATION. Si tu es sur Jellyfin <= 10.11.8, reste sur v0.8.0. Si tu es sur 10.11.9, v0.8.1 ou v0.8.2 marchent les deux. Si tu es sur 10.11.10+, v0.8.2 recommande.

v0.8.1 - HOTFIX CRITIQUE Jellyfin 10.11.9 : la propriete IUserManager.Users a ete supprimee dans Jellyfin 10.11.x (breaking change patch) au profit de la methode GetUsers(). Le plugin v0.8.0 (build contre SDK 10.11.6) crashait avec MissingMethodException 'Method not found: ... IUserManager.get_Users()' sur les routes /MaintenanceDeluxe/users-summary, /MaintenanceDeluxe/announcements/admin, et lors de l'activation maintenance (MaintenanceHelper.ActivateAsync). Pire : les exceptions remontaient dans les handlers ItemAdded/Updated/Removed de Jellyfin (via la stack DI partagee), cassant des fonctionnalites core du serveur. Fix : (1) bump Jellyfin.Controller + Jellyfin.Model de 10.11.6 -> 10.11.9 (csproj plugin ET csproj tests). (2) Remplacement de _userManager.Users par _userManager.GetUsers() sur 3 call sites : BannerController.GetUsersSummary (ligne 549), BannerController.GetAdminAnnouncements (ligne 704), MaintenanceHelper.ActivateAsync (ligne 138). (3) targetAbi du manifest passe de 10.11.6.0 a 10.11.9.0 - les serveurs Jellyfin sur 10.11.6/7/8 ne pourront plus installer v0.8.1+ via le manifest (downgrade SDK pas backward-compatible). Si tu es sur 10.11.6-8, reste sur v0.8.0 ou upgrade Jellyfin. TESTS : 279/279 verts sur le nouveau SDK 10.11.9 (aucune logique modifiee, juste l'API de IUserManager). PAS D'AUTRE CHANGEMENT cote feature - c'est strictement un hotfix de compat ABI.

v0.8.0 - Tour de fixes a11y + UX + CI robustesse (4 agents en parallele, +13 tests = 279 verts). A11Y: (1) Focus trap dans toutes les modales (dangerConfirm admin + showAnnouncementModal + Carousel + Stack banner.js) - Tab/Shift+Tab cycle dans la modale, capture/restore du document.activeElement. (2) Scroll lock body lors d'affichage modale annonce (overflow:hidden sur documentElement+body, restore au close). (3) Compteur carousel SR-friendly - counterEl cree une fois hors render() avec aria-atomic=true, mutation via textContent au lieu d'innerHTML wipe. (4) prefers-reduced-motion respecte (theme neon pulse, badge dirty pulse, jfDconfFade overlay animation, preview neon glow). (5) Contraste WCAG AA sur badges - draft #E8A33D->#FFD27A + opacity 0.18->0.28, expired #D9534F->#FF8A87 + opacity 0.15->0.30, expiring + schedule-incomplete aussi rehausses. (6) Touch targets 44x44 minimum sur .jf-dconf-btn (padding 8->12) et .jf-url-btn (padding 7->12 + min-height 44 + inline-flex). (7) Focus visible outline doree sur les inputs .jf-ann-field. (8) backdrop-filter fallback solide via @supports not (backdrop-filter) - fallback opaque pour vieux Chromium TV. UX: (9) Webhook test button desactive pendant la requete avec texte 'Test en cours...', reenable() partage entre then/catch. (10) Import config: _pendingImport=null sur Cancel/ESC/backdrop, garde Apply qui affiche feedback si pas de fichier selectionne, closeImportModal() centralise. (11) Release notes delete confirmation via dangerConfirm si la section a du contenu (titre/body/icon non vides), delete direct sinon. v0.7.0 - Audit secondaire : 11 fixes (3 securite + 4 robustesse + 4 polish), 32 nouveaux tests xUnit (234 -> 266). (1) CRITIQUE banner.js checkTimeWindow overnight wrap : les banniers/annonces avec fenetre daily 22:00-06:00 retournaient toujours false, donc invisibles la nuit alors que le C# MatchesTimeWindow gerait correctement le wrap. Divergence client/serveur corrigee. (2) SSRF defense webhook URL : nouvelle helper IsWebhookHostSafe qui rejette loopback IPv4/IPv6 (127.0.0.0/8, ::1), link-local 169.254.0.0/16 (incl. AWS/Azure/GCP metadata endpoints), RFC1918 prive (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), IPv6 ULA fc00::/7, hostnames .localhost/.internal/.local, et localhost literal. Appliquee sur SaveMaintenance webhook URL ET TestWebhook endpoint. (3) WebhookNotifier log sanitization : SanitiseExceptionMessage strippe les URLs+tokens du message exception avant logging (LogWarning ne contient plus la URL discord avec son token). TestAsync retourne message generique a l'admin UI au lieu de ex.Message qui pouvait leak hostnames internes via SSL cert errors. (4) Init defensif Announcements + AnnouncementsSeen avec = new() property-level (en plus du constructeur) : XmlSerializer peut bypasser le constructeur sur XML legacy nil tags, laissant ces props null et causant NRE. (5) ValidateSchedules WeekDays empty/null : au lieu de rejeter (regression v0.6.1), auto-normaliser type='always'. Preserve la compat avec configs legacy qui avaient ce cas comme 'never-active' silencieux. (6) DetectFormat URL host parsing au lieu de substring match : avant, 'https://relay.com/discord-bot/api/webhooks/proxy' etait classifie Discord (faux positif). Maintenant utilise Uri.Host exact match (incl. canary.discord.com, ptb.discord.com). (7) GetActiveSessions snapshot ToList avant LINQ : evite race condition sur _sessionManager.Sessions collection mutable. (8) ClonePublicFields rendu internal + reutilise par MaintenanceScheduleTask au lieu de son snapshot field-by-field qui manquait ScheduledStart/End/ActivatedAt. (9) WebhookNotifier 429 Retry-After : respecte le header (en seconds ou HTTP-date), retry si <= 4s d'attente. (10) Webhook payload size cap 32KB : evite Discord/Slack/proxy 400 sur payloads trop gros (admin avec customTitle+customSubtitle+message tres longs). (11) banner.js tick() defensive null check sur CONFIG : si fetch /config fail (plugin disabled mid-session, network blip), CONFIG reste null et chaque CONFIG.* etait NRE. (12) LastModified monotone : Math.Max(old, now) protege contre les horloges qui reculent (NTP correction). TESTS : 32 nouveaux (15 cas checkTimeWindow overnight JS, 7 SSRF blocklist hosts, 6 boundary public ranges, 5 DetectFormat regression guards substring-match, ValidateSchedules WeekDays auto-correct 2 cas, NormaliseCssColor bounds revisited). 234 -> 266 verts.

v0.5.2 - Phase 2 annonces : Schedule fixed/annual/weekly/daily. Les annonces beneficient maintenant du meme systeme de planning que les rotation messages des bannieres. Cinq types : always (par defaut, pas de filtre), fixed (fenetre de date precise YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM start/end), annual (recurrent par mois/jour avec optional time window, gere le wrap d'annee comme Christmas Dec 20 -> Jan 5), weekly (jours de la semaine au choix + fenetre horaire), daily (juste une fenetre horaire quotidienne, gere les fenetres overnight 22:00->06:00). Implementation : nouvelle helper C# AnnouncementHelper.IsScheduleActive(schedule, now) qui mirror exactement le JS isInSchedule existant des banner messages. Filtre ajoute dans IsTargetedAtUser. Validation SaveAdminAnnouncements reutilise ValidateSchedules existant. UI : fieldset 'Planning' ajoutee dans l'editeur d'annonce, reutilise les helpers getScheduleDetailHtml + wireScheduleEditor + populateSchedule + collectSchedule existants des rotation messages (composant identique, juste rendu dans un contexte different). Badge summary 'Planning' bleu affiche en plus du badge etat quand schedule != always : 'Fenetre fixe' / 'Annuel' / 'Hebdo: Lu Ma Me' / 'Quotidien 09:00-17:00'. Le client recoit la liste deja filtree, aucune logique client modifiee. 14 nouveaux tests xUnit couvrent IsScheduleActive : null/always (3 cas), fixed avec bornes ouvertes/fermees (4 cas), annual avec year-wrap Christmas (3 cas), weekly day-of-week + empty list (3 cas), daily avec overnight window Theory (8 cas), unknown type fallback, integration IsTargetedAtUser_RespectsSchedule. 169 tests v0.5.1 -> 183 tests v0.5.2 (+14).

v0.5.1 - Phase 2 annonces : brouillon + auto-expire. Deux nouveaux champs admin pour reduire la friction sur les annonces (preparation a l'avance + nettoyage automatique). (1) BROUILLON : nouveau toggle 'Brouillon' dans l'editeur, separe de Active. Une annonce en brouillon reste visible dans la liste admin avec un badge orange dashed, mais le serveur ne la sert jamais aux users finaux meme si Active est coche. Permet de preparer le contenu d'une annonce a l'avance puis de la publier en un clic en decochant Brouillon. Filtre serveur ferme dans AnnouncementHelper.IsTargetedAtUser : draft -> not delivered. (2) AUTO-EXPIRE : nouveau champ 'Expire apres (jours)' (1-365, vide = jamais). Quand renseigne, le serveur filtre automatiquement les annonces dont PublishedAt + ExpireAfterDays est passe. Filtrage stateless dans AnnouncementHelper.IsExpired : pas de mutation, pas d'auto-archive (l'annonce reste visible en admin avec un badge rouge barre 'Expiree' pour que l'admin sache pourquoi elle n'est plus servie). Cas limites : 0 ou negatif = traite comme 'no expiration' (drop a la sauvegarde par le clamp serveur). PublishedAt null = jamais expire (safe default). (3) BADGES SUMMARY : la pilule a droite de chaque ligne annonce affiche maintenant 5 etats possibles : Active (vert), Inactive (gris), Brouillon (orange dashed), Expiree (rouge barre), Active (Xj) (orange si <=7 jours avant expiration). Priorite : draft > expired > inactive > active. (4) VALIDATION SERVEUR : POST /announcements/admin clamp ExpireAfterDays a 1-365 (>365 -> 365, <=0 -> null) pour eviter typos 365000 ou negatif qui creerait une annonce permanenly-expired. IsDraft est un bool simple. (5) TESTS : 13 nouveaux cas xUnit couvrant draft never-delivered, expired filtre, IsExpired boundaries (-10j, -7j exact, -3j, 0j, days=0, days=-5), null PublishedAt safe default, integration SelectDeliverableForUser. 156 tests v0.5.0 -> 169 tests v0.5.1 (+13).

v0.5.0 - Phase 2 annonces partielle : modes carousel et stack enfin actifs cote client. Depuis v0.3.9 (Phase 1), le selecteur 'Mode d'affichage' de l'admin offrait 3 choix (one-at-a-time / carousel / stack) mais le client retombait toujours sur one-at-a-time quel que soit le reglage. v0.5.0 ferme la promesse : (1) CAROUSEL : si plusieurs annonces non vues a delivrer, le client affiche UNE modale avec deux chevrons gauche/droite et un compteur '1 / N' en bas. Chaque slide a son propre theme et accent applique a l'overlay (palette + police + animation), le marquage 'vu' fire-and-forget se fait quand on quitte la slide via fleches OU au close final. Navigation clavier : fleche gauche/droite, ESC pour fermer. Sur mobile (<=700px), les chevrons collapsent en bas de l'ecran. (2) STACK : toutes les annonces empilees verticalement dans une seule modale scrollable, avec header 'N annonces' et un seul bouton sticky 'Tout marquer comme vu' en bas. Pas de bouton 'Compris' par carte, c'est le bouton global qui POST /seen sur les N IDs en parallele. Mode utile quand l'admin a beaucoup d'annonces non-critiques regroupees. (3) Edge case respecte : si une seule annonce non-vue est disponible, le mode est ignore et on retombe sur la modale classique (pas de carousel-a-1-slide ridicule ni de stack-a-1-carte vide). REFACTOR : extraction de buildAnnouncementCardHtml(a, withOk) (fonction pure, retourne le HTML de la carte) et createAnnouncementOverlay(themeKey, accent) (cree l'overlay vide). Reutilises par les 3 modes (one-at-a-time + carousel + stack). buildAnnouncementModal devient un wrapper de 5 lignes. CSS : 26 nouvelles regles scopees via #jf-ann-overlay.jf-ann-carousel et #jf-ann-overlay.jf-ann-stack, zero impact sur le mode one-at-a-time existant (aucune regression sur v0.4.1). TESTS : aucun changement cote backend C# (la logique de selection annonce/mode est deja faite cote serveur). 156 tests xUnit toujours verts. Les pieges (banner.js ASCII-safe, escape \u2039 \u203a pour les chevrons) appliques.

v0.4.1 - Audit complet de revue de code apres v0.4.0 : 14 fixes appliques (1 securite + 13 qualite/perf/UX), 0 changement de comportement attendu pour les configs valides. SECURITE : (1) Faille XSS via URL protocol-relative dans les liens Markdown des annonces et des bannieres : `[click](//evil.com)` etait accepte par le regex `^(https?:\/\/|\/)` et generait `<a href="//evil.com">` qui navigue vers l'host attaquant. Fix client (banner.js linkSafeUrl + safeUrl ligne 510 + ctaUrl ligne 1848 + annMdRender admin.js ligne 3196) et serveur (IsUrlSafe BannerController.cs) avec lookahead `\/(?!\/)` qui rejette explicitement `//host`. Nouveaux tests xUnit pour `//evil.com`, `//evil.com/path`, `///triple-slash`. QUALITE : (2) Validation manquante des couleurs CSS sur ColorPresets / BannerMessage.Bg|Color / PermanentEntry.Bg|Color dans SaveConfig - un admin pouvait persister `red;position:fixed;top:0` (XSS CSS via inline-style). Nouvelle helper NormaliseHexColorOrDefault avec fallback typiquement-defaut. 7 tests. (3) ValidateRoutes rejette desormais les sequences `..` et `//` consecutives (defence en profondeur, route patterns Jellyfin n'en contiennent jamais). 8 nouveaux tests. UX : (4) Nouvelle modale `dangerConfirm` pour les actions destructives (suppression annonce, reset seen, activation maintenance avec sessions actives en cours) : remplace `window.confirm` par une vraie modale avec liste des elements affectes, conseil contextuel, et delai 2-3s sur le bouton danger pour empecher les clics accidentels. Style CSS dedie (.jf-dconf-*) avec animation, ESC pour annuler. PERF : (5) Refactor SelectDeliverableForUser de O(announcements x seenEntries x usersPerEntry) a O(announcements + seenEntries) via HashSet lookup (50k comparaisons sur 1000 users x 50 annonces -> ~1k). Test stress sur 100 annonces / 50 entries seen. ROBUSTESSE : (6) maybeShowAnnouncements capture le token dans une closure et revalide via getToken() apres le delai 800ms : si l'user logout pendant ce delai, le fetch programme est abandonne au lieu de tirer avec l'ancien token. (7) banner.js efface l'overlay annonce existant avant d'en construire un nouveau (race rafetch rapide). (8) postMessage live-preview (admin->banner.js) cible window.location.origin au lieu de '*'. (9) banner.js coalesce les bursts de md-preview-update via setTimeout 33ms (~30fps) : un parent malveillant ou un auto-save buggy ne peut plus pegger le CPU. (10) updatePreview admin debounced 120ms par keystroke au lieu de re-parser le markdown a chaque touche. (11) Validation des dates schedule sur Maintenance : rejet explicite des Invalid Date au lieu de comparaisons NaN <= NaN silencieuses. (12) togglePanel admin : iteration sur childNodes pour trouver le textNode (l'icon child cassait `.firstChild.nodeValue`). TESTS : 136 tests v0.4.0 -> 159 tests v0.4.1 (+23 : URL protocol-relative, hex color, route hygiene, perf stress).

v0.4.0 - Systeme de themes visuels pour les annonces. 4 themes au choix : Velours et Or (le look actuel, defaut), OLED Total Black (fond noir pur monochrome avec JetBrains Mono, ideal ecrans OLED), Glow Neon (halo color rotatif selon importance avec Space Grotesk geometrique futuriste et pulse animation), Glassmorphism (fond tres flou translucide avec Manrope rond elegant, look macOS / Vision Pro). 4 polices web premium embarques (140 KB total : Inter, JetBrains Mono, Space Grotesk, Manrope) servies par le plugin sous /MaintenanceDeluxe/fonts/ avec cache immutable 1 an. v0.3.13 - Modal annonce centree + premium + templates rapides. (1) Fix critique de centrage : la modal apparaissait en haut a gauche en mode toast au lieu de centree plein ecran. Cause : un ancestor Jellyfin (body ou skinBody) avec transform/filter/will-change creait un containing block pour position:fixed, qui se rattachait a cet ancestor au lieu du viewport. Fix : CSS hardcode avec !important + 100vw/100vh explicites + append a document.documentElement (html) au lieu de body pour echapper a tout transform parent. (2) Style premium : backdrop blur passe a 8px, fond rgba(0,0,0,.68) plus contraste. (3) Templates rapides : 7 modeles pre-remplis dans l'admin pour ajouter une annonce en 1 clic au lieu de tout retaper (Mise a jour serveur, Nouveaux films, Maintenance prevue, Amelioration perfs avec comparisons, Annonce communautaire, Evenement, Alerte critique). Bouton dedie par modele dans la section Annonces. Bouton 'Nouvelle annonce' renomme '+ Annonce vide' pour clarifier l'alternative.

v0.3.12 - Fix critique : la modal d'annonce ne s'affichait pas apres login. Le hook fetchAndShowAnnouncements ne tournait qu'une seule fois au load initial de banner.js. Si l'user etait sur la page login (pas de token) au moment du chargement du script, le code exit early avant le hook annonces. Apres login - SPA navigate vers home - le hook n'etait jamais re-trigger. Fix : nouvelle fonction maybeShowAnnouncements() idempotente (track token deja checke) appelee dans refetchAndApplyMaintenance qui s'execute a chaque navigation SPA (hashchange / popstate / viewshow). Au passage de login (no-token -> token), le hook se declenche automatiquement avec un petit delay 800ms pour laisser la home page se mounter visuellement. Reset auto du flag au logout pour que la prochaine connexion re-trigger. Aucune autre regression - le init initial fonctionne identique pour les users deja loggues au chargement.

v0.3.11 - Fix critical : cache busting des assets admin apres upgrade plugin. Le user a constate apres l'install de v0.3.10 que l'UI admin restait identique a v0.3.9 (layout casse, pas de live preview) parce que le browser servait l'ancien admin.js/admin.css depuis son cache (Cache-Control: max-age=300 introduit en v0.3.4). Reecriture du helper ServeEmbeddedAsset : utilise maintenant ETag base sur la version d'assembly + Cache-Control 'public, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Au lieu de cacher 5 minutes en aveugle, le browser revalide a chaque navigation via If-None-Match - 304 Not Modified si la version n'a pas change (zero body, tres rapide), 200 avec nouveau code si upgrade plugin detecte. Cette classe de bug 'stale admin UI apres upgrade' qui frappait v0.3.4-v0.3.10 est definitivement fermee : a partir de v0.3.11, chaque release force un fetch frais des assets sans intervention de l'admin.

Reecrit en grid CSS 2 colonnes (form gauche, preview right) avec fieldsets thematiques (Identite / Corps / Etat / Cible / Comparaisons / CTA) + sub-grids responsifs (mobile 1 col, desktop 2-3 cols). (3) Aucune previsualisation. Ajout d'un panneau live preview a droite de chaque editeur qui rend la modal d'annonce telle qu'elle apparaitra cote user, avec accent colorise selon l'importance + comparisons en mini-table + footer. Mise a jour en temps reel a chaque keystroke. v0.3.8 - Audit fonctionnel complet. NETTOYAGES : suppression du script mort scripts/check_inline_script.py (plus utilise depuis v0.3.7 ou l'inline JS a ete extrait), retrait du prefixe redondant '[MaintenanceDeluxe]' de tous les logs C# (depuis v0.3.7 BeginScope et le LogCategory remplissent deja ce role). REFACTOR : 359 lignes de CSS inline extraites de configPage.html dans Configuration/admin.css (EmbeddedResource + nouvel endpoint GET /MaintenanceDeluxe/admin.css public, meme modele de securite que admin.js). configPage.html passe de 1329 a 971 lignes (-27%, total -78% depuis v0.3.5). v0.3.7 - Refactor qualite (suite audit). (1) Tests d'integration : extrait deux helpers purs supplementaires PartitionDeactivationTargets et SelectUsersNeedingReDisable dans MaintenanceHelper. La logique de deactivation et de drift check est maintenant 100% testable sans Plugin.Instance ni mock IUserManager. 6 nouveaux tests xUnit qui couvrent : classification 3-buckets (a re-enable/malformed/missing), input vide, all-valid, drift no-op (healthy), drift partiel, skip silencieux des malformes. 89 tests au total (83 v0.3.6 + 6 nouveaux). (2) Logging structure : BeginScope ('Activate', 'Deactivate', 'DriftCheck') sur les operations multi-step de MaintenanceHelper, plus LogTrace pour le drift no-op (debug ciblé sans pollution Information). (3) Refactor majeur configPage.html : 3048 lignes de JS inline extraites dans Configuration/admin.js (EmbeddedResource + endpoint GET /MaintenanceDeluxe/admin.js public, meme modele de securite que banner.js). configPage.html passe de 4376 a 1329 lignes (-70%). CI adapte : remplace l'extraction du inline JS par node --check direct sur admin.js, plus une regle qui refuse tout retour de inline script dans configPage.html. Le risque historique des fix critiques v0.1.11/v0.1.12 (admin UI cassee par parsing JS inline) est definitivement clos.

v0.3.6 - Apercu admin agrandi : la carte remplit maintenant la zone visible. Quand l'admin clique 'Agrandir l'apercu' dans le panneau Apparence, la carte de prevue s'elargit pour occuper l'espace disponible (max-width 1400 px ou 92vw selon le plus petit) au lieu de rester en mode compact 640 px et de paraitre perdue dans le fond aurora. Implementation : postMessage 'md-preview-expanded' du parent admin vers l'iframe au moment d'entrer/sortir du mode agrandi, banner.js applique une classe CSS jf-md-preview-expanded dediee uniquement valide en mode live-preview. Le rendu cote utilisateurs finaux Jellyfin reste totalement inchange (la classe n'est jamais appliquee hors preview admin).

v0.3.5 - Tests integration + bump GHA actions. (1) Couverture tests : refactoring leger de MaintenanceHelper qui extrait deux pure functions IsAdmin / IsDisabled / SelectUsersToDisable / SelectPreDisabledIds, plus 9 nouveaux tests xUnit qui verifient que la partition utilisateurs (admins / pre-disabled / whitelistes / a desactiver) est correcte dans tous les cas (incluant l'invariant critique disjoint des deux listes). 83 tests au total (74 v0.3.4 + 9 nouveaux). (2) GHA actions bumpees aux versions actuelles : actions/checkout@v6, setup-dotnet@v5, setup-node@v6, setup-python@v6 (etaient en v4/v4/v4/v5). Le FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24 ajoute en v0.3.4 retire car les nouvelles actions ciblent Node.js 24 nativement.

v0.3.4 - Polish post-audit (suite v0.3.3). (1) UX webhook : nouvelle checkbox 'Notifier avant un redemarrage serveur' dans le tab Maintenance pour piloter le NotifyOnRestart ajoute en v0.3.3 (par defaut active). v0.3.3 - Audit complet du plugin : 12 fixes (2 securite + 8 robustesse + 2 polish). (1) Securite : GET /config retourne desormais un DTO BannerClientConfig sans webhook URL ni listes UUID (etait lisible par tout user authentifie) ; nouvel endpoint GET /config-admin (RequiresElevation) pour la page admin. (4) Cache-Control max-age=10 sur GET /maintenance pour reduire la charge de polling. (5) JS Injector retry exponentiel 5/15/45/120/300/600 s (~18 min) au lieu de 3x5s, avec try/catch propre dans le Task.Run. (6) MaintenanceScheduleTask refactore : single Plugin.Instance read par tick, plus coherent. (7) SaveMaintenance : single SaveConfiguration au lieu de double save (fenetre de race fermee). (8) Webhook URL : log warning si host non Discord/Slack (generic webhooks toujours acceptes). (9) Borne sup scheduledRestart a 30 jours pour eviter les configs polluees. v0.3.1 - Webhooks Discord/Slack + whitelist utilisateurs. (1) Notifications webhook : envoie un payload HTTP a chaque activation/desactivation de maintenance. Format Discord, Slack ou JSON generique auto-detecte depuis l'URL. Bouton 'Tester la notification' avec rate-limit 1 appel/5s par IP. URL HTTPS uniquement (pas de http://). Si le webhook est down, la maintenance s'active/se desactive quand meme - le webhook ne peut jamais bloquer le toggle. Doc payloads : docs/webhooks.md. (2) Liste blanche utilisateurs : nouveau widget multi-select dans la section Maintenance qui liste tous les utilisateurs Jellyfin. Les utilisateurs coches conservent leur acces pendant la maintenance (parfait pour la famille, l'astreinte, un compte de test). Les utilisateurs supprimes apparaissent en italique avec un bouton 'Retirer'. Edge case : un user ajoute apres l'activation reste desactive jusqu'au prochain toggle. (3) Privacy : l'endpoint public /MaintenanceDeluxe/maintenance ne renvoie plus les listes UUID (whitelist, disabled, pre-disabled) ni l'URL webhook - elles ne fuitent plus aux callers anonymes. Le admin UI passe par /config (auth) qui contient le state complet. (4) Backend : nouveau WebhookNotifier statique avec timeout 5s + 1 retry. Endpoint POST /maintenance/test-webhook et GET /users-summary, tous deux RequiresElevation.

v0.1.13 - UI FIX: gold card border was truncated when release notes made the overlay taller than the viewport. The card had its own internal scroll (max-height:92vh) so the ::before gold gradient didn't extend through scrolled content. Fix: overlay scrolls instead of card, card grows to full content height so the border wraps everything, and background layers (blobs, beams, grain, particles) are pinned to viewport with position:fixed.

v0.1.12 - CRITICAL FIX: Save button stopped reacting as soon as any field was modified. Root cause: a TypeError in collectMessages() aborted initDom before the Save handler got wired, because release-note rows shared the .jf-msg-row class with rotation messages and had no .jf-msg-detail. Fix: excluded .jf-rn-row from the rotation collector + defensive null guard in collectRowData.

v0.1.11 - CRITICAL FIX: admin config page was entirely unresponsive since v0.1.8. Root cause: release-note templates had real newlines inside JS string literals, causing the whole inline admin script to fail parsing. Every button, input, and save handler silently died. Now fixed — admin UI fully interactive again, tested with node --check.

v0.3.0 - Quality release: bug fixes + anti-data-loss + French admin UI. (1) Bugs: BannerController endpoints now return 503 if the plugin instance is not yet initialised instead of serving phantom defaults; ScheduledRestart is preserved when set after a maintenance window (only cleared if it was inside the window); MutationObserver and hideScrollObserver are now properly torn down on pagehide (no more memory leak after long sessions); live-preview postMessage receiver enforces same-origin checks (no cross-origin injection of overlay config). (2) Anti-data-loss: orange dot badge next to Save when there are unsaved changes, browser warning if you try to close the tab with unsaved changes, automatic localStorage draft autosaved every 500ms with restore prompt on next load, inline validation that flags scheduledEnd before scheduledStart and scheduledRestart in the past. (3) French admin UI: the Maintenance tab, Save button, save-confirmation modal, alerts and validations are fully translated to French. (4) The live-preview iframe now shows a clear fallback after a 5s timeout if the iframe never reports ready.

v0.2.3 - Two polish fixes on the new Appearance panel. First, the 'Agrandir l'apercu' button used Jellyfin's default emby-button which rendered with a white background on the dark admin theme; it now uses the same neutral-translucent style as the Reset button so it fits both light and dark themes. Second, new 'Rotatif' border option: a luminous gold gradient that slowly spins around the card, paired with a soft pulsing glow. Speed follows the animation scale slider (including the 'off' toggle).

v0.2.2 - Fine-tune beyond the presets. Every Animation speed and Particle density preset now has a companion numeric input (0-5× scale for animations, 0-500 for particle count). Click a preset to fill the number; type a number to override with any value in-range. Layout: appearance preview is now sticky (it follows you as you scroll the controls column), iframe min-height bumped to 540px so long release notes fit, controls column is tighter, expand-mode settings panel narrowed from 340px to 300px so the preview gets more room.

v0.2.1 - Polish on the new Appearance section: live preview iframe now loads correctly (the preview shell and banner.js endpoints no longer require Authorization headers that browsers don't send on iframe navigation, fixes 401 errors). The three enum selectors (animation speed, particle density, card border) are now segmented pill controls instead of plain radio buttons - much more readable and consistent with modern UI. Reset appearance button restyled so it is legible on both light and dark themes. Appearance labels, alerts and preview copy translated to French.

v0.2.0 - Appearance customization with live preview. New admin section lets you pick accent color, background tint, card opacity, animation speed (off/slow/normal/fast), particle density (none/low/normal/dense), and card border style (full gradient / simple gold / none). A live preview iframe reflects every change instantly without saving. Expand button gives a fullscreen view with toggleable settings panel (H hotkey) and Esc to exit. All colors are now derived from a single accent pick, so the palette stays coherent whatever hue you choose.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.7.7 - Fixed the real cause of 'Telegram only sends when I click Test': every event-type checkbox (Playback Start, Stop, etc.) defaulted to off, so real playback events were silently dropped at the delivery queue's event-enablement check while the Test button, which bypasses that check, kept working. New installs now default Start/Stop to on, and existing installs are auto-recovered at save time if notifications and a destination are active with zero event types ever configured -- without overriding an explicit choice made in the same save. Saving Discord or Telegram settings now also persists the current event-subscription checkboxes, instead of only the separate Preferences section doing so. Fixed 'Copy Diagnostic Report' being permanently blocked when opened from Jellyfin's own standard Dashboard -> Plugins route, which always carries a '?name=playbackcard' query string the report's own validator was rejecting. Poster image upload failures (Discord, Telegram) no longer drop the notification outright, both now fall back to a plain text message if the image itself gets rejected. Parallelized the Local Network/Remote geolocation lookups so a page with several concurrent remote sessions and a cold cache no longer waits on them one at a time.

Release v0.2.7.6 - Discord/Telegram notifications now attach the item's poster image directly, uploaded as part of the same request rather than a link back to the server, so it works even on servers that aren't internet-reachable; falls back to text-only when no image is cached (on by default, can be turned off). The summary strip gains a live bandwidth gauge showing total outbound bitrate, split by Local Network vs. Remote when that badge is enabled, plus an optional percentage against an admin-configured upload limit. Sessions paused a while now show a warning pill (escalating from amber to red past an hour) so a forgotten paused stream holding server resources doesn't go unnoticed, and a badge appears when one account has more than one stream running. The Send Message admin action now offers quick-fill presets, and the Info panel gets a Copy Report button producing a sanitized per-session technical summary (no username, device, or IP) for sharing in a forum post or issue. Added a Recent Sessions shelf -- a short in-memory history of finished playback, cleared on restart, no database. Also fixes two Telegram bugs: saving a bot token no longer requires a Chat ID to already be set, and notification duration text no longer wraps past 24 hours.

Release v0.2.7.5 - Added a second Info view: click Info while 'Right' is selected (next to the existing 'Down' toggle) to open a centered dialog with the poster on the left and the full Tautulli-style Product/Player/Quality/Stream/Container/Video/Audio/Subtitle/Location/Bandwidth field list on the right, instead of expanding the card in place. The original Down behavior is unchanged. Transcode reasons are now itemized with red/amber severity, shown both as a details-panel banner and as warning rings on the affected pills, so it is clear at a glance why a stream is transcoding and how serious it is. Compact/Extended switches and opening Info now animate instead of snapping open. Also adds a strictly opt-in (off by default) Local Network/Remote badge, with an optional city/country lookup for remote sessions via a third-party geolocation service -- the raw IP address is never exposed or logged.

Release v0.2.7.4 - Added detection for stale, superseded plugin version folders left behind after an update. Jellyfin's own plugin loader can, in rare cases, silently keep running an old build instead of a newer one already installed (a real bug in Jellyfin itself, tracked upstream as jellyfin/jellyfin#17699) -- when that happens, fixes from later releases never take effect, with no error shown anywhere. The plugin now checks for this at every startup and logs a warning if found, and the System Diagnostics section shows a banner naming the older folder(s) with an explicit 'Remove' button per folder. Removal is always an admin-confirmed, one-click action -- never automatic -- and it refuses to remove anything unless it can positively confirm the folder belongs to this plugin and is strictly older than the version currently running.

Release v0.2.7.3 - Replaced hand-drawn approximate client icons with verified real logos: Apple, Apple TV, Linux, Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Chromecast, Kodi, Google TV, and Chrome (the real current multi-color logo). Official Jellyfin apps (Web/Mobile/Android TV/Desktop) now show Jellyfin's actual mascot mark instead of a generic device outline. Moonfin, Finamp, and Streamyfin icons now match their real app logos instead of approximate shapes. Fixed the original bug properly: the Apple TV and Linux icons weren't just small, they were using a near-black fill against a near-black card background and were rendering as almost invisible. Added a small PlayInfo watermark badge to the corner of every card so the data source is identifiable at a glance.

A new feature has been added to the plugin: safety breaker. When the server serves traffic without the correct HTTP Header, it will trip (if the safety breaker is enabled) and disable the plugin. This is intended to catch misconfiguration that could result in people gaining access to the server.
Note that when the breaker trip, it will be visible in the configuration page.

Also, the configuration page now shows up which user is currently logged in with the header that was last saved, this should help with debugging.

### Fixed

- Fix procedure to aquire auth token for alternative Spotify provider after recent changes made by Spotify

## [1.12.0.0] - 2024-12-07

### Added

- Workaround regarding the recent Spotify API changes (#48)

# Changelog

## [1.11.0.0] - 2024-11-30

### Added

- Support for manually mapping tracks between Spotify and Jellyfin (#44)

### Fixed

- Keep iterating through artists even after a first match was found (in case multiple artists with the same name exist)
- Fix exception getting user playlists due to changes in the Spotify API (#46)

# Changelog

## [1.10.0.0] - 2024-09-14

### Added

- New option to set playlists as private or public to all users

### Fixed

- Exception if Spotify returns duplicate playlists for a user

# Changelog

## [1.9.0.0] - 2024-08-25

### Added

- New setting to enable imported "progress" to be displayed in the playlist description -> #30
- New matching type to extract an album name from the track name (like 'Track [From "An Album"]') and use that for comparison

### Changed

- Updated Jellyfin dependencies to match version 10.9.9
- Switch request handling on plugin config page to use jellyfin custom fetch mechanism

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.1] - 2024-06-21

### Fixed

- Include missing Fastenshtein dependency in build artifacts

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.0] - 2024-05-19

### Fixed

- Broken API endpoints (due to authorisation policy changes in Jellyfin introduced in 10.9)

# Changelog

## [1.8.0.0] - 2024-05-17

### Added

- Support for Jellyfin 10.9
- New configurable flag for each playlist whether or not to recreate it from scratch each time the task runs
- New matching type "fuzzy checking" for track and album names

### Changed

- "Ignore Parentheses" now treats [] the same as ()
- Some rework of the track matching process (again); the plugin now tries to find all potential matches first and then decides a "best fit" track name

# Changelog

## [1.7.2.0] - 2024-03-29

### Fixed

- Accept matches where Spotify uses a different track syntax than metadata providers (e.g. "Track Name - Super Remix" on Spotify and "Track Name (Super Remix)" on MusicBrainz) if at least match level `Ignore Case + Punctuation` is used

## [1.7.1.0] - 2024-03-18

### Changed

- Reintroduce the old track matching method as a configurable legacy alternative (not recommended to be used)
- Extend logging information / debug possibilities

## [1.7.0.0] - 2024-03-10

### Changed

- If a track / album / artist contains text in parentheses, this content will be used as another match candidate (e.g. to match tracks that have an english translation of a foreign name)

### Fixed

- Fix broken track matching if multiple artists of a track exist in Jellyfin, but the track is not located under the first existing artist
- Fix not matching tracks if their album is not a direct child of their artist and (for whatever reason) only detectable via the album artist

## [1.6.0.0] - 2024-02-23

### Changed

- Search Jellyfin server for artist instead of individual tracks and narrow track matching down from there
- Search Jellyfin server using only the first few characters of an artist name to increase chances of finding matches with slightly different names
- Use all (album) artists from Spotify to check whether a matching artist exists in Jellyfin, not just the first one

### Fixed

- Catch exceptions from Spotify API lib when retrieving users / playlists

## [1.5.0.0] - 2023-12-16

### Added

- New switch to control where missing track files are stored
- Add new matcher to ignore anything in parentheses in track/album/artist names

### Fixed

- Fix Spotify username regex not allowing special characters

## [1.4.0.0] - 2023-10-15

- More verbose logging that can be enabled

### Changed

- Reworked handling of Spotify user IDs to get all their playlists (moved to its own table separate from individual playlist IDs)

### Fixed

- Fix bug in config page that reset all unsaved table row states when adding a new row
- Fix parsing of Spotify URLs that contain parameters

## [1.3.0.0] - 2023-08-13

### Fixed

# 🚀 A New Foundation for File Transformation File Transformation **3.0.0.0** is a major overhaul of how the plugin integrates with Jellyfin. The transformation system has been rebuilt around standard ASP.NET Core middleware, removing much of the version-specific runtime patching that File Transformation previously relied on. Alongside **Jellyfin 12 support**, this release drops support for **Jellyfin 10.10.7** and lays a much more maintainable foundation for future Jellyfin releases. > ## 🙌 Huge thanks to @4eh5xitv6787h645ebv > > A massive part of this release is thanks to **@4eh5xitv6787h645ebv**, who took on the major overhaul of File Transformation's core architecture in PR #58. > > The move away from the old Harmony/MonoMod-based interception system to standard ASP.NET Core middleware is a significant piece of work. It not only makes File Transformation substantially easier to maintain, but also resolves an entire class of compatibility problems that caused the plugin to malfunction or be disabled on certain Jellyfin versions and platforms (#20, #35, #62, #64, #70, #71). > > This is far more than a small patch or isolated feature - it fundamentally improves the foundation the plugin is built on. A huge thank you for the time and effort that went into it. ## ✨ New Features * Added support for **Jellyfin 12** and the newer Jellyfin server architecture (#34). * Replaced the previous Harmony/MonoMod-based web interception system with standard ASP.NET Core `IStartupFilter` middleware (PR #58, @4eh5xitv6787h645ebv). * Added support for unregistering transformations through `PluginInterface.RemoveTransformation(Guid)`, allowing dependent plugins to cleanly remove transformations when required. * Added support for synthesising virtual files for registered transformation paths, restoring support for plugins such as Plugin Pages where the underlying file doesn't physically exist. * Added ETag generation and `304 Not Modified` support for transformed content. * Added Brotli and gzip recompression of transformed responses for remote clients. * Added automatic MIME type detection for virtual transformed files. ## 🛠️ Improvements * Removed platform-specific DLL extraction and version-specific Jellyfin shims. * Removed dependencies on Harmony, MonoMod and Prometheus from the core transformation pipeline. * Improved compatibility across Jellyfin versions and platforms by moving the transformation system onto standard ASP.NET Core APIs (#20, #35, #62, #64). * Added per-transformation error isolation so a failure in one plugin's transformation won't prevent other transformations from running. * Made transformation registration, removal and execution thread-safe. * Added regex caching and timeout protection for transformation matching. * Improved handling of `Accept-Encoding`, including proper quality-value (`q`) parsing. * Improved LAN detection for IPv6-mapped IPv4 addresses. * Improved proxy caching behaviour by correctly setting `Vary: Accept-Encoding`. * Reworked HTTP handling to use a shared `HttpClient` with appropriate timeouts. * Hardened named-pipe transformations with timeouts, size limits, EOF handling and improved resource cleanup. ## 🪲 Bug Fixes * Fixed a class of failures where Harmony/MonoMod runtime patching could cause File Transformation to malfunction or be automatically disabled on startup (#20, #35, #62, #64, #71). * Fixed #70 where transformations could attempt to use a disposed `IServiceProvider` after Jellyfin restarted, resulting in `500` responses across the web UI. * Fixed transformed content potentially retaining stale trailing bytes when a transformation produced a shorter result than the original response. * Fixed failures in one transformation potentially breaking the entire transformation pipeline. * Fixed potential `HttpClient` resource leaks. * Fixed named-pipe transformations being able to hang indefinitely or loop on zero-byte reads. * Fixed incorrect handling of disabled compression encodings such as `gzip;q=0`. * Fixed failed virtual-file transformations returning an empty successful response instead of reverting to the original `404`. * Improved middleware failure handling so the original response is served if transformation or recompression fails. ## 💻 Developer Compatibility The existing `PluginInterface.RegisterTransformation` API and registration payload remain compatible with previous releases, so plugins using a standard transformation callback **should not need to change how they register transformations**. There are, however, some changes to transformation execution that plugin developers should be aware of: * Added `PluginInterface.RemoveTransformation(Guid)`, allowing plugins to explicitly unregister a previously registered transformation. * Assembly callbacks still receive the same payload and are expected to return the transformed content as a `string`. * Invalid or failed assembly callbacks now **fail safely rather than falling through to another configured callback mechanism**. Plugins should ensure their callback assembly, class and method names are valid. * HTTP transformation callbacks must now return a **successful HTTP status code**. Non-success responses are treated as a failed transformation rather than using the response body as transformed content. * HTTP callbacks now have a **15 second timeout**. * Named-pipe callbacks now have connection/error handling and a **50 MB maximum response size**. * Failed transformations now leave the original response untouched rather than potentially replacing it with invalid or partial output. These changes are intended to make transformations significantly safer and more predictable, but plugins relying on the previous fallback or error behaviour should review their integrations when updating. ## ⚠️ Compatibility * **Jellyfin 10.10.7 is no longer supported.** * Added support for **Jellyfin 12** and its newer server architecture (#34). * Users remaining on Jellyfin 10.10.7 will need to stay on an earlier File Transformation release until they upgrade Jellyfin. * Removed legacy Harmony/MonoMod runtime patching and version-specific Jellyfin shims. * File Transformation now relies on standard ASP.NET Core middleware rather than patching Jellyfin internals, providing a much more stable base for future Jellyfin versions. ## Contributors * 4eh5xitv6787h645ebv ## ❤️ Support If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27). Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

# 🎬 Media Bar Arrives on Jellyfin 12

Media Bar **3.0.0.0** brings support for **Jellyfin 12**, including compatibility with both the classic desktop experience and Jellyfin's newer modern web layout.

> ## 🙌 Huge thanks to MakD and the upstream contributors
>
> Media Bar itself is the work of **MakD and the contributors to the upstream Media Bar project**. The plugin I maintain is primarily a Jellyfin wrapper around that work, exposing configuration and integration points so it can be installed and managed cleanly as a Jellyfin plugin.
>
> A huge amount of effort has gone into keeping Media Bar working across Jellyfin's changing web interface, especially for Jellyfin 12. The features, UI work and frontend improvements in this release are built on that upstream work, and the credit for that belongs to **MakD and everyone contributing there**.
>
> My part is largely packaging, integrating and exposing that work through Jellyfin's plugin system.

## ✨ New Features

* Added support for **Jellyfin 12**.
* Added support for Jellyfin 12's **modern React/MUI home screen layout**, alongside the existing classic desktop layout.
* Updated the bundled Media Bar frontend to the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream version.
* Added Jellyfin 12-specific styling so Media Bar integrates correctly with the new web-client shell while retaining the existing appearance on the classic layout.
* Media Bar continues to ship its frontend assets directly with the plugin, ensuring the version displayed in Jellyfin matches the plugin version you've installed.

## 🛠️ Improvements

* Synced Media Bar with the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream work.
* Improved Media Bar placement within the Jellyfin 12 home screen across both supported layouts.
* Improved layout behaviour on taller displays, ensuring Jellyfin's home-screen rows remain below the Media Bar content rather than overlapping its controls.
* Improved localisation handling when loading Jellyfin's translation chunks.
* Retained support for the **Get updates early** option for users who explicitly want to track unreleased upstream Media Bar changes.

## 🪲 Bug Fixes

* Fixed Media Bar being inserted in the wrong position when using Jellyfin 12's modern layout (#181).
* Fixed translated Media Bar strings falling back to English or producing JSON decoding errors for some languages (#185).
* Fixed home-screen rows overlapping Media Bar buttons on taller viewports.
* Fixed Jellyfin 12 layout differences that could cause Media Bar to render incorrectly compared with Jellyfin 10.11.

## ⚠️ Compatibility

* **Media Bar 3.0.0.0 supports Jellyfin 10.11.11 and Jellyfin 12.**
* Users on older Jellyfin 10.x versions should remain on a compatible **2.x** Media Bar release.
* Jellyfin 12 support includes both the **classic Desktop layout** and the newer **modern React/MUI layout**.
* A compatible **File Transformation 3.x** release is required.
* If you're using the **Get updates early** option, unreleased upstream Media Bar changes may behave differently from the frontend bundled and tested with this plugin release.

## Contributors

* austinnorgaard
* judarange

## ❤️ Support

If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27).

Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

✨ New Features

- Added an option to **enable or disable syncing the Jellyfin page backdrop with the current Media Bar slide** (#174).
- Media Bar's JavaScript and CSS are now **served directly from the installed plugin by default**, rather than being fetched from jsDelivr. This ensures the frontend always matches the installed plugin version and allows Media Bar to work without internet access (PR #175, @skylerwshaw).
- Added an optional **Get updates early** setting for users who want `main` or `latest` to continue tracking unreleased upstream changes through jsDelivr (PR #176, @skylerwshaw).
- Merged with upstream.

🛠️ Improvements

- Explicit version tags and commits can still be used to load a specific Media Bar version from jsDelivr, while the recommended default now uses the assets bundled with the plugin.
- Improved handling of embedded Media Bar assets, including correctly returning `404` for resources that don't exist.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the slideshow timer lifecycle so changing slides doesn't inadvertently restart or leave behind an old timer (PR #178, @ACertainCoder).
- Fixed requests to `index.html` unexpectedly rewriting the saved Media Bar version configuration.
- Removed an unreachable legacy 10.11 asset fallback as part of the move to embedded frontend assets.

- ACertainCoder
